name: San Jose Youth Commission and Youth Advisory Council
what_you_do: Teens advise the San Jose Mayor and City Council on youth issues. The Youth Advisory Council (YAC) is open now; Youth Commission recruitment is closed.
who_can_apply: Youth Advisory Council: ages 13 to 19 who live in a San Jose City Council district. Youth Commission: ages 14 to 20. You must live in the district you represent. The term is two years (up to two terms). It meets 4th Monday at 6:30 p.m.
deadline_text: Youth Advisory Council (open now): no deadline posted. Youth Commission (closed): recruitment is closed, no reopening date posted.
how_to_apply: The Youth Commission is closed now. Only the Youth Advisory Council is open. Fill out the District Youth Advisory Application for the YAC. A Youth Commissioner contacts you within about two weeks.
notes: Page is hosted by the library. Some council districts are unavailable or paused. YAC members earn community service hours. Pay not mentioned.
